verdict.rationale: Canny's MCP server uses account sign-in rather than issuing scoped API keys ('No API keys, no engineering'), and there is no documentation of creating least-privilege or scoped credentials for agents; the OpenAPI spec probes also failed to reveal any token-scoping mechanism. missing for 10: any mention of scoped/limited-permission API tokens, role-based agent credentials, or documentation of credential scoping for AI agents.
